::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 91,877 people lived in County Laois, up 8.5% on 2016. It had the 18th largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 60% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Laois was €1,235, the 12th highest of the 26 counties.
:::
